about: Baselines for npm run ratchet (tools/ratchet.ts). No count may rise; when one falls, lower it here in the same PR (npm run ratchet -- --update). Set 2026-10-16 (P1-01b). sourceJavascriptFiles (the site's own JavaScript in src/) set 2026-10-17 (P1-05), when the site's inline code became files; raised to 87 on 2026-10-17 (P1-07, with Theo's agreement) for src/engine/rng.js and src/engine/clock.js, which P1-09 renames to .ts in place; raised to 88 on 2026-10-18 (P1-18d, with Theo's agreement) for src/ui/gm/turn-shell.js, the turn's shell split out of src/engine/run-turn.js, which P1-09 renames in place too; raised to 94 on 2026-10-18 (P1-08a, with Theo's agreement: each P1-08 row raises it for the files it lifts code into) for the six new files under src/engine/ (turn/, realms/, titles/, heroes/), which P1-09 renames in place too; raised to 101 on 2026-10-18 (P1-08b, the same rule) for the seven new files under src/engine/ (battle/, units/, turn/, magic/); to 108 (P1-08c, the same rule) for seven more; to 109 (P1-08d, the same rule) for src/engine/turn/realm-reports-and-spy-stealth.js; to 115 (P1-08e, the same rule) for the six new files under src/engine/personal-combat/; to 118 (P1-08f, the same rule) for two more there and src/engine/heroes/hero-death-and-leaderless-hosts.js; to 120 (P1-08g, the same rule) for src/engine/battle/battles-against-province-defenders.js and src/engine/battle/pre-battle-duels.js; to 121 (P1-08h, the same rule) for src/engine/battle/battles-between-heroes.js; to 124 (P1-08i1, the same rule) for src/engine/turn/phase-intents-and-dependency-ordering.js, src/engine/world/routes-and-distances.js and src/engine/world/province-bookkeeping-and-rallied-garrisons.js. stubDbTests raised to 80 on 2026-10-18 (P1-18a, with Theo's agreement) for tests/page/turn-shell.test.ts, the one file the P1-18 series adds on the stand-in database (P1-18d's and P1-18e's page tests go in it too).
